source_snapshot.procedure: During POST, press F7 when the hint appears, inspect the displayed information and verify entry to the boot selection menu; collect captures and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: POST BIOS version/release date must be readable and correct, and the SUT must enter the boot selection menu successfully.
source_snapshot.script: No script; 3 attended and 3 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly states that an agent cannot press a pre-OS F7 key over SSH and requires an operator, but omits safe selection/exit and evidence controls.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY at MEDIUM risk; requires a qualified operator or approved pre-OS console, expected POST/menu fields, capture, safe target/exit behavior and post-boot verification.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly protects the essential physical/pre-OS interaction from false SSH automation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps MANUAL ONLY and adds target identity, POST timing, capture, safe menu navigation and final-state recovery.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Surrounding reboot and readback may be assisted, but the timed observation and F7 action remain human-owned; blind input is prohibited.

original_test_intent: Verify that the intended SUT shows correct readable BIOS version and release-date information during POST and that F7 entered at the advertised time opens the expected boot selection menu.
original_method: A qualified operator observes and records POST, presses F7 only at the displayed prompt, captures the boot selection menu, exits or selects only an approved safe target, then confirms normal boot and unchanged boot configuration.
manual_activity: A qualified operator watches the actual POST display, times and presses F7, verifies the menu visually and performs only the approved exit or boot selection; automation can assist with timestamps and post-boot readback.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board identity and expected BIOS version/release date
POST F7 prompt text and timing window for the installed BIOS
Expected boot selection menu identity and allowed entries
Approved safe exit or boot target and unchanged-boot-order requirement
Physical keyboard/display or validated pre-OS KVM path
Timestamped capture, normal-boot and console/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not substitute SSH or blind timed keystrokes for observed POST interaction
Verify the SUT and displayed prompt before pressing F7
Do not enter setup, change boot order or select unapproved removable/network media
Capture POST information before it disappears and preserve the raw display evidence
Stop on an unexpected menu, ambiguous input focus, unreadable display or wrong target selection
Use the approved recovery path if normal boot is lost; no automatic reboot retry
Confirm the final boot target and settings before returning the SUT
agent_execution_scope: Validate expected identity, POST fields, menu and safe target policy
Prepare timestamped capture and surrounding read-only baseline
Guide but not replace the operator's observed F7 interaction
Correlate POST and menu captures to the same boot attempt
Collect post-boot firmware, target and boot-order readback
Report evidence without issuing the hardware verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the expected POST/menu fields, input path and safe exit/target
Perform or supervise the timed pre-OS F7 action
Recover any unintended selection or boot-state change
Review captures and final state and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no OS command can perform or prove the observed POST F7 interaction. Its manual note needs menu identity, capture and safe-exit controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No blind command is authorized. Use a qualified operator with direct display/keyboard or a validated pre-OS KVM, record POST and F7-menu evidence, and use read-only post-boot commands only for corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F7 timing, POST information, boot-selection result, no-script status and 3/3-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record one continuous POST-to-menu sequence showing the version/date, F7 prompt, operator input and resulting menu, then verify safe exit/approved boot and unchanged boot settings.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds continuous evidence, input-focus/target controls, safe exit and final-state verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Post-boot logs alone cannot prove the prompt was readable, the key was accepted at the correct time or the expected menu appeared.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote KVM may alter keyboard mapping or latency and is acceptable only if its pre-OS F7 behavior has been validated for this platform.

project_override_considerations: A Project may approve validated pre-OS KVM instead of a local keyboard, but must retain the visible prompt-to-menu evidence and cannot reclassify an SSH-only reboot as coverage of the hotkey action.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS identity, expected version/release date, F7 prompt/menu and safe-target matrix
Timestamped continuous POST capture with readable version/date and visible F7 hint
Operator action record and resulting boot-selection menu capture
Safe exit or approved target selection plus final normal-boot and boot-order readback
Relevant event/log review, recovery record if applicable and no-unintended-change audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and both Criteria consistently describe the F7 POST hotkey and boot-menu result. Missing timing and menu details are platform inputs, not contradictory source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A qualified operator or validated pre-OS console can perform the essential interaction once the platform oracle and recovery path are provided.

review_improvement: Preserves DeepSeek's honest manual boundary while adding continuous POST evidence, safe menu navigation, post-boot state checks and recovery controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: The evidence chain must join prompt visibility, keystroke timing and resulting menu in the same boot attempt. A later boot-menu photo or OS boot alone cannot distinguish correct F7 handling from firmware default behavior or an unrelated menu path.
